class_definition: A path the a729 image itself names, as a bare working-directory-relative filename, and binds to a runtime output sink. The operative property is proved by a COMPLETE reference census of the string literal: every reference to it in the image is named in this document, and every one of them is a raw C/C++ stream-I/O site or an output-sink field binding. No content-resolution path anywhere in the image names the literal, so the engine never asks the Clausewitz layered VFS for it, so it is not content of any mounted namespace -- and its presence in the effective-VFS base namespace was an over-collection by the raw directory walk, not a policy question. Membership is never decided by a filename convention, an extension, or a directory position.

evidence.access: read: std::basic_ifstream over the literal in the CConsole constructor; write: fopen append, fprintf, fclose on every accepted console command
evidence.note: Census: two PARAM references plus the pointer slot, and nothing else. 0x14206ac60 (ref 0x14206af4b) constructs CTextBufferObserverGlue<CConsole> and reads the file back to repopulate history at startup. 0x14206b710 (ref 0x14206b82d) opens it with mode string "a" at 0x142ad47e4 and appends one line through format string "%s\n" at 0x142ae2ab8. Both are raw stream I/O on the bare literal; neither goes through the VFS.

evidence.access: the ImGuiIO constructor assigns the literal into the IniFilename output-sink field (+0x18)
evidence.note: Census: two references, both in 0x1421b5390, and nothing else -- so no content-resolution path names this literal. writer_function is NULL on purpose: the open site reaches the path through the ImGuiIO field rather than through the literal, so no address for it is claimed here. What IS proved beyond the field binding is the content: 0x1421ca520 emits the settings text through format strings "[%s][%s]" (0x142b1ecf8), "Pos=%d,%d" (0x142b1ed08) and "Collapsed=%d" (0x142b1ed28), and the imgui.ini present in this install root is exactly that shape. Evidence: runs/jq_console_key/re_string_xrefs.txt and re_string_xrefs_imgui_writer.txt.

evidence.access: the ImGuiIO constructor assigns the literal into the LogFilename output-sink field (+0x20)
evidence.note: Census: two references, both in the same constructor as imgui.ini, and nothing else. Absent from this install; it appears only once the debug UI logs, which is exactly why walking the install root cannot be trusted to describe product content -- the same product would be two different products depending on whether this file had been created yet. Evidence: runs/jq_console_key/re_string_xrefs_imgui_log.txt.
